name: Bacon, Snap Pea & Asparagus Broth with Minted Ricotta Toast

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
3 small bunches asparagus
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onions; place in a large bowl.
Halve snap peas crosswise. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Add both to the bowl with the onion and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes.
When the bacon is done, add veggies to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth and spices to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 ½ tsp thyme, dried
2 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut lemons into wedges and set aside for serving.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl along with ricotta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread if desired; spread with half of the minted ricotta (reserve remaining minted ricotta for the soup).
When the soup is done, add the remaining minted ricotta, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls; serve with lemon wedges and toast on the side. Enjoy!
